segments.caption: A man in a white shirt stands outdoors beside a dark car, speaking directly to the camera. A subtitle appears, stating, “Please be advised: This tutorial is only a guide,” indicating he is delivering an instructional or advisory message in a natural, outdoor setting.

A man in a light-colored shirt stands outdoors beside a dark car, speaking and gesturing as if giving a presentation. The scene then cuts to him seated inside the driver’s seat, where he demonstrates a feature by reaching toward the center console, indicating he is reviewing or showcasing the vehicle’s interior.

A man in a light blue shirt is shown interacting with a car’s interior and exterior features, beginning by adjusting a control on the center console, then gripping the gear stick, before turning to face the camera while seated behind the wheel, and finally touching the car’s alloy wheel.

A person is attending to a flat tire on a car, first inspecting the damaged tread, then kneeling beside the vehicle to explain the situation, and finally retrieving a portable air compressor from the trunk to attempt a repair, with a roadside assistance advertisement for ŠKODA displayed.

A man in a white shirt and orange safety vest stands by his open car trunk, having just retrieved a small bottle and a test strip. He then proceeds to use the test strip to test the contents of the bottle, suggesting he is performing a roadside breathalyzer or similar test, likely for alcohol or another substance.

A man in an orange high-visibility vest is shown changing a flat tire on the side of a road. He begins by preparing an air compressor, then kneels beside the car to attach the nozzle to the valve stem of the tire, indicating he is inflating or checking the tire pressure as part of the repair process.

A man in an orange safety vest kneels by a car on the side of a road, using a portable air compressor to inflate a tire. The sequence shows close-ups of the nozzle being inserted into the valve stem and the compressor being operated, indicating he is addressing a low tire pressure issue.
A person in an orange safety vest kneels beside a car on the side of a road and begins checking the tire pressure using a handheld digital gauge, inserting the probe into the valve stem.
A man in a high-visibility vest kneels beside a car and uses a portable air compressor to inflate a tire, connecting the hose to the valve stem and operating the device.

A person is shown inflating a car tire using a portable air compressor, beginning with connecting the hose to the valve stem, then operating the device, and finally pausing to address the camera while kneeling beside the vehicle.
A man in a bright orange safety vest kneels beside a black SUV, then stands up as the trunk opens behind him, speaking directly to the camera in an outdoor, wooded setting.

A man in an orange safety vest stands by an open car trunk, then is shown inside the vehicle, looking concerned as he checks his tire pressure with a gauge, suggesting he’s dealing with a flat or low tire on a roadside.
A man is driving a car, looking concerned as he checks his tire pressure using a gauge, referencing a manual that emphasizes the importance of correct tire inflation for vehicle safety and longevity.

A man is driving a car while visibly distressed, his face contorted in frustration or concern. On-screen text provides a warning: he must drive at a maximum speed of 50mph, accelerate, brake, and corner gently, as this is a temporary measure and he must see a local ŠKODA or tyre retailer immediately. The scene suggests he has received a vehicle warning or fault code that requires urgent attention.

A man with dark, curly hair sits in the driver's seat of a car, looking toward the camera with a pained or distressed expression. His eyes are squeezed shut in the first frame, then slowly open as he appears to be speaking or reacting emotionally, his mouth moving and his brow furrowed. The background shows green foliage outside the car window, indicating he is parked or driving through a natural, wooded area.

A man with dark, curly hair sits in the driver's seat of a car, looking directly at the camera with a slightly strained or concerned expression. The scene then cuts to a white screen displaying "Useful Contacts" with the ŠKODA UK website and two phone numbers for roadside assistance and customer services.
